justification: Deterministic address-uniform queue independent of detailed REST slots. Four logical portfolio attempts per 15-minute tick reserve at most 80 weights, averaging 5.333 weights/minute; internal HTTP retries remain separately charged by the shared limiter telemetry. New candidates and 24-hour refreshes share this cap and deterministic queue order. Consecutive failures are capped at six; any successful refresh resets the failure count. Recent shared telemetry measured 844.83 reserved weights/minute over 60 minutes and 853.70 over 24 hours with zero 429s. The existing local limiter remains authoritative; no request bypasses it. No AI budget or RE call is included.
